8:41: Akken ibɣu yili wayen id tɣeltem n cci, cfut amur wis smus n Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, akked llzem, igujilen, imeɣban, win d ibbwi ubrid; ma illa tumnem s Ṛebbi akked wayen id Nessers i umdan nneɣ, ass n ufraz, ass ideg mlalent snat n trebbuyaɛ. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
8:42: Mi tellam di loiha taqṛibt, u nitni agwemmaḍ, imnayen seddawat wen, xas temyefkem ţţaɛud, tzeglem timlilit. Maca, iwakken ad Isɛaddi Ṛebbi lameṛ ara iɛaddin, ad immet win immuten, s ubeggen, ad yidir win idren, s ubeggen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issel, d Amusnaw.
8:43: Mi k ten id Issenɛat Ṛebbi, d takwemmict, di targit ik ... Lemmer ik ten id Issenɛat qwan, war ccekk, a ţfeclem, a ţţemnamarem ɣef lameṛ. Maca, Ṛebbi Ijbeṛ ikwen. Ih, Neţţa Issen i illan deg idmaren.
8:44: Mi wen ten Issenɛat, mi ten temmugrem, twalam ten d takwemmict. Iẓẓemẓi kwen ar tmuɣli nnsen, iwakken ad Isɛaddi Ṛebbi lameṛ ara iɛaddin. Ar Ṛebbi ţţuɣalen lumuṛ.
8:45: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d arbaɛ, tebbtet, mmektit ed aṭas Ṛebbi, amar a ţrebḥem.
8:46: Aɣet awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ur ţţemnamaret. Mulac a ţfeclem, a ţnegfem. Ṣebṛet! S tideţ, Ṛebbi ar iṣebṛiyen.
8:47: Ur ţţilit am wid id iffɣen s temɣweṛ, seg ixxamen nnsen, iwakken a ten id walin medden. Swexxiṛen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Izzi i wayen xeddmen.
8:48: Mi sen icebbeḥ Cciṭan igiten nnsen, u inna: "ur kwen iɣelleb yiwen seg imdanen, ass agi. Nek d amalal nnwen". Mi mwalant snat trebbuyaɛ, iuker aḍaṛ, inna: "nek xḍiɣ kwen, nek walaɣ ayen ur twalam, nek ugadeɣ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Iqseḥ deg uɛaqeb".
8:49: Mi nnan ixabiten akked imehzulen n wul: "wigi, iɣuṛṛ iten ddin nnsen". Win iţţeklen ɣef Ṛebbi, ihi, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
8:50: Lemmer a ţwaliḍ mara ddment lmalayek leṛwaḥ n wid ijehlen, ad kkatent udmawen nnsen, izugar nnsen. "Jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb n tmeṛɣiwt!
8:51: Ayagi ilmend n wayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen", u Ṛebbi ur ţdennis imdanen.
8:52: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferɛun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Nekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Issemḥaleq asen Ṛebbi s ibekkaḍen nnsen. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Iqseḥ deg uɛaqeb.
8:53: Akka, acku Ṛebbi ur Iţbeddil lɣit is Iɣat agdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
8:54: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferɛun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen n Mass nnsen. Nenɣa ten s ibekkaḍen nnsen, Neɣmeq agdud n Ferɛun; llan akw d imednas.
8:55: ɣuṛ Ṛebbi, imexlaq ucmiten maḍi, d wid ijehlen, dɣa ur uminen,
8:56: wid ukud tgiḍ lemɛahda, sinna, di yal tikelt, neqḍen lemɛahda nnsen, u nitni ur ţḥezziben.
8:57: Ma tugareḍ ten di ṭṛad, sserwel yissen wid i ten id iḍefṛen, amar a d mmektin.
8:58: Ma tugadeḍ lexdaɛ seg ugdud, err iten akin, s tezdeg. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara ixeddaɛen.
8:59: Ur ţɣilin menɛan, wid ijehlen. Nitni, s tideţ, ur zmiren.
8:60: Heggit asen d ayen iwumi tzemrem n lemḥella akked yimnayen, a ţţessagwdem yissen acengu n Ṛebbi, acengu nnwen, akked wiyaḍ, war segsen, ur tessinem; Ṛebbi Issen iten. Ayen tseddqem n cci, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ad awen d iuɣal. Kunwi ur teţwadensem.
8:61: Ma nudan talwit, nadi eţ. Pţkel ɣef Ṛebbi. Neţţa, s tideţ, Issel, d Amusnaw.
8:62: Ma bɣan a k xedɛan, ihi, ɛammed ɣef Ṛebbi, Neţţa i k Ifkan afus s tallalt iS, akked lmumnin.
8:63: Issemlal ulawen nnsen. Lemmer a ţṣeṛfeḍ i illan akw di tmurt, ur tessemliliḍ ulawen nnsen. Maca, Ṛebbi Issemlal iten. Neţţa, s tideţ, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
8:64: A Nnbi! Ɛammed ɣef Ṛebbi, kečč, akked wid iddan yidek si lmumnin.
8:65: A Nnbi! Eg lḥir i lmumnin, ad nnaɣen. Ma llan segwen warem iṣebṛiyen, ad rnun snat twinas. Ma llan segwen twinas, ad rnun agim n wid ijehlen, acku, nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.
8:66: Tura, Issafes Ṛebbi fellawen. Iẓṛa tella garawen rrehma. Ihi, ma llan segwen twinas iṣebṛiyen, ad rnun snat twinas, ma llan segwen agim, ad rnun sin igima, ma Irad Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi ar iṣebṛiyen.
8:67: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi ad isɛu imeḥbas, alamma ţwaɣelben di tmurt. Tebɣam tukci n ddunit. Ṛebbi Ibɣa laxeṛt. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
8:68: Lemmer mačči d ayen iuran sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, izwar ed, yili a kwen iwwet uɛaqeb abarar, ilmend n wayen tebbwim.
8:69: Eččet ayen ilhan, iḥellen, seg wayen i tɣelltem, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
8:70: A Nnbi! Ini i wid teṭṭfem seg imeḥbas: "ma Iufa Ṛebbi lxiṛ deg ulawen nnwen, ad awen Ifk ayen yifen ayen i wen iţwakksen, ad awen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu".
8:71: Ma bɣan a k xedɛan, niɣ iuɣ lḥal xedɛen Ṛebbi. Dɣa, Ikkes asen ṛṛay. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
8:72: Ih, wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden s wayla nnsen, akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Wid iumnen ur unagen, ur awen llin d imeddukwal, s wacemma, alamma unagen. Ma ţţren afus nnwen di ddin, iwata yawen ad asen tefkem afus, siwa mgal agdud ukud tɛaqdem. Ṛebbi Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
8:73: Wid ijehlen d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Ma ur tgim ara akka, a ţţili lfetna di tmurt, akked usefsed ameqwṛan.
8:74: Wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak, s tideţ, d lmumnin. I nitni ssmaḥ akked lɣit ukyis.
8:75: Wid iumnen syin ɣer da, u unagen, u juhden yidwen, widak segwen. Llzem ţţemyilin kteṛ di Tezmamt n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izṛa yal cci.
9:1: Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS kksen aḥeţţem i imcurak ukud tɛaqqdem.
9:2: Ddut di tmurt kuẓ wagguren. Cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Ṛebbi, u Ṛebbi ad Isdull ijehliyen.
9:3: Aberreḥ i medden, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ass n ḥioo ameqwṛaḥan, ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, kksen aḥeţţem i imcurak. "Ma testeṛoɛam, ţţif i kunwi, ma twexxṛem, cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Ṛebbi". Becceṛ wid ijehlen s uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
9:4: Kkes ed wid ukud tɛaqqdem seg imcurak, sinna ur kwen bbwiḍen s wacemma, ur ullen yiwen mgal nnwen. Ṭṭfet di lemɛahda nnsen ar lmudda s. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iḥemmel wid iţḥezziben.
9:5: Mi ɛaddan wagguren iṛqan, nnaɣet imcurak anda ten tufam. Ṭṭfet ţen, ḥeṛset ţen, andit asen yal taxettalt. Ma steṛoɛan, ẓẓulen, zekkan, ooet asen abrid. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
9:6: Ma issuter ak laɛnaya, yiwen seg imcurak, ḥareb fellas, ard issel i wawal n Ṛebbi, sinna, ssiweḍ it s amkan is n laman. Akka, acku nitni, s tideţ, d agdud ur nessin.
9:7: Amek ara tili i imcurak, lemɛahda sɣuṛ Ṛebbi u sɣuṛ Umazan iS, siwa wid tɛahdem ar Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam. Skud sweqmen yidwen, sweqmet yidsen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iḥemmel wid iţḥezziben.
9:8: Amek, mi kwen ɣelben, ur kwen qudṛen ilmend n yiɣes, neɣ n lemɛahda. Ṛuḍan kwen s imawen nnsen; ulawen nnsen ugin. Tegwti segsen d iballaɣen.
9:9: Uɣen s issekniyen n Ṛebbi ayen ṛxisen. Ssefṛaɣen ɣef ubrid iS. S tideţ, ay dir wayen xeddmen nitni!
9:10: Ur qudṛen lmumen ilmend n yiɣes, neɣ n lemɛahda. Wigi, ih, d wid izegren tilas.
9:11: Ma steṛoɛan, ẓẓulen, zekkan, d atmaten nnwen di ddin. Neţfeṣṣil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
9:12: Ma sḥenten tagalit nnsen, deffir lemɛahda nnsen, u wwten di ddin nnwen, nnaɣet iqweṛṛa n tijehli. Nitni, s tideţ, ur ţţaṭafen di tgallit. Amar ad fukken.
9:13: Day ur teţnaɣem ara agdud i isḥenten tagalit nnsen, u ibɣan ad ssuffɣen Amazan, u nitni heomen kwen d imezwura? Day ten tugadem? D Ṛebbi i iklalen a T tagwadem, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
9:14: Nnaɣet ţen, a ten Iɛaqeb Ṛebbi s ufus nnwen, a ten Ixzu, a kwen Iserbeḥ fellasen, ad Icfu idmaren n ugdud n lmumnin.
9:15: Ad Ikkes urrif n wulawen nnsen. Ṛebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:16: Day tɣilem a ţţeţwaterkem, wanag ur Iẓṛi Ṛebbi wid, degwen, ijuhden, ur neddi d imawlan, war Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, akked lmumnin? Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ay txeddmem.
9:17: Ur issefk ara i imcurak ad kecmen leowamaɛ n Ṛebbi, ad cehhden ɣef tijehli nnsen. Widak neqḍen igiten nnsen, di tmes ad wekkṛen.
9:18: Ara ikecmen kan leowamaɛ n Ṛebbi, d wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, iẓẓulen, izekkan, iţţagwaden siwa Ṛebbi. Ahat wigi ad ilin seg wid iţwanhan.
9:19: Day terram win i isswan iẓaɛlak, i ibedden i Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, am win iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru u innuɣ deg ubrid n Ṛebbi? Ur aɛdilen ar Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
9:20: Wid iumnen, iunagen, u nnuɣen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi s wayla nnsen akked iman nnsen, aɛlay umekkan nnsen, ar Ṛebbi. Wigi d wid ara irebḥen.
9:21: Ibecceṛ iten Mass nnsen s uḥunu sɣuṛeS, akked llza, akked leonanat, degsen ssaɛd imezgi;
9:22: ad wekkṛen degsen i lebda. Ih, ar Ṛebbi, arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
9:23: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţarat d imawlan, ibabaten nnwen akked watmaten nnwen, ma smenyafen tijehli i liman. Wid segwen i ten iran d imawlan, ad ilin, nitni, d imednas.
9:24: Ini: "maday, sennig Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, akked umennuɣ deg ubrid iS, ay tḥemmlem ibabaten nnwen, tarwa nnwen, atmaten nnwen, tilawin nnwen, alag nnwen, ayla i tkesbem, ttjaṛa i tugadem a ţţeɣli, tinezduɣin i kwen iɛaoben, ihi, gganit ar d Ias Ṛebbi, s lameṛ iS. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballaɣen.
9:25: Niɣ Isrebḥ ikwen Ṛebbi deg waṭas imukan, akked wass n Ḥunain, mi kwen taɛoeb ṭṭaqa nnwen. Ur awen d tebbwi acemma. Tamurt iwsɛan, tuɣal awen tediyeq. Dɣa tezzim d, trewlem.
9:26: Sinna, Issers ed Ṛebbi talwit iS ɣef Umazan iS, akked lmumnin, Issers ed iɛsekṛiwen ur teţwalim. Iɛaqeb wid ijehlen. D wagi ay d aqeṭṭi ijehliyen.
9:27: Sinna, deffir waya, Ṛebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
9:28: A wid iumnen! Imcurak maɛfunit kan. Ur d ţqeṛṛiben ar Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, mara ifukk useggwas agi nnsen. Ma tugadem lqella, a kwen Iɣit Ṛebbi, s lfeḍl iS, ma ihwa yaS. Ih, Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:29: Nnaɣet wid ur numin ara s Ṛebbi, u s wass aneggaru, ur ţgeddilen ayen Igdel Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ur xeddmen ddin n tideţ, seg wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, alamma xelṣen tabzert s war amunnu, d imejjṭuḥen.
9:30: Nnan wudayen: "Ɛuzayeṛ d mmi S n Ṛebbi". Nnan imasiḥiyen: "lmasiḥ d mmi S n Ṛebbi". Ayagi, nnan t id s imawen nnsen. Pţaɛwaden d awal n wid ijehlen, n zik. A ten Ineɣ Ṛebbi! Acḥal ṭeṛṛifen!
9:31: Rran lquṛṛaḥ nnsen, ixelwiyen nnsen, lmasiḥ mmi s n Meryem, d imawlan war Ṛebbi. Pwamṛen kan ad ɛabden Ṛebbi Yiwen; ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Gedha syiS, seg wayen ţcaraken!
9:32: Bɣan s yimawen nnsen ad ssexsin tafat n Ṛebbi. I Ibɣa Ṛebbi, ad Itim kan tafat iS, di nneqwma ijehliyen.
9:33: D Neţţa id Iuznen Amazan iS, s nnhaya akked ddin n tideţ, iwakken a t Issifer ɣef ddin meṛṛa, xas ugin ijehliyen.
9:34: A wid iumnen! Aṭas n lqweṛṛaḥ d ixelwiyen, s tideţ, teţţen d aḥerfi ayla n medden. U ṭeṛṛifen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Wid ixeznen ddheb d lfeṭṭa, ur ten ţseddiqen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, becceṛ iten s uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
9:35: Ass ideg ara ṛɣen di tmes n Loahennama, ad kwin, yissen, inyiren nnsen, ibeṛdiyen nnsen, iɛrar nnsen. "D ayagi ay txezznem i iman nnwen. Jeṛṛbet ayen txezznem!"
9:36: Ih, ar Ṛebbi, amḍan n wagguren: mrawsin; di Tezmamt n Ṛebbi, ass ideg Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan. Garasen, kuẓ ṛqan. D wagi ay d ddin n ddwam. Ur ddenniset iman nnwen degsen. Nnaɣet ijehliyen ɣef ccfa, akken i kwen nnuɣen ɣef ccfa. Cfut, Ṛebbi Iteddu d wid iţḥezziben.
9:37: Aswexxeṛ n waggur d timerniwt kan n tijehli. Nnetlafen yis wid ijehlen. Aseggwas a t ḥellen, aseggwas a t gedlen, iwakken ad wafqen amḍan n wayen Igdel Ṛebbi. Ad ḥellen ayen Igdel Ṛebbi. Ɛaoben ten yir igiten nnsen. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
9:38: A wid iumnen! Acu kwen iuɣen? Ma nnan awen: "hejjmet ar ubrid n Ṛebbi", a ţţebrum i iman nnwen. Day kwen taɛoeb tmeddurt n ddunit, sennig tin n laxeṛt? Zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit d amejṭiṭuḥ kan, zdat win n laxeṛt.
9:39: Ma ur tehjjimem ara, a kwen Iɛaqeb s lqeṛḥ, a d Iawi agdud nniḍen, deg umekkan nnwen. Ur T teṭṭuṛum s wacemma. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
9:40: Ma ur t tsellkem, ihi, Isellek it Ṛebbi, mi t ssuffɣen wid ijehlen. Wissin n sin, mi llan deg ifri, mi inna i umeddakwel is: "kkes aɣwbel, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, yidneɣ". Issers ed Ṛebbi talwit iS fellas, Iɛawen it s iɛsekriwen, ur ten twalam. Isseɣli maḍi awal n wid ijehlen. Awal n Ṛebbi, neţţa, aɛlay sennig akw. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:41: Hejjmet fessusit u ẓẓayit, juhdet s wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Pţif wakka i kunwi, lemmer teẓṛim.
9:42: Lemmer d abaɣuṛ isehlen, d inig wezzilen, yili ḍefṛen k in. Maca, ɣwezzif fellasen umecwaṛ. Ad ggalen s Ṛebbi: "lemmer nezmir, yili neffeɣ yidwen". Nnɣan iman nnsen, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ar nitni, war ccekk, d ikeddaben.
9:43: Ad ak Isemmeḥ Ṛebbi! Acimi i sen tserḥeḍ? Ard ak d iban anwi innan tideţ, a ţţissineḍ ikeddaben.
9:44: Ur ak d ssutren ara tsriḥ, wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, mi juhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Ṛebbi Issen wid iţḥezziben.
9:45: I k issutren tsriḥ, d wid ur numin s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru. Cukken wulawen nnsen, dɣa, s ucukku nnsen, kukran.
9:46: Lemmer bɣin tuffɣa, yili heggan as d ayen ilaqen. Maca, Iugi Ṛebbi ad ţţucegɛan, Iurez iten. Nnan asen: "qqimet d wid iqqimen".
9:47: Lemmer ffiɣen yidwen, ar awen rnun siwa ccwal. War ccekk, ad kecmen garawen, bɣan ahewwel nnwen. Kra segwen ssemḥasen asen. Ṛebbi Issen imednas.
9:48: Niɣ bɣan, si zik, ahewwel. Sxeṛben ak lumuṛ, armi d tusa tideţ. Iḍehṛ ed lameṛ n Ṛebbi, nitni ur bɣin.
9:49: Garasen win id innan: "serreḥ iyi, ur iyi gar di lfetna"! Day ur ɣlin ara di lfetna? Loahennama, s tideţ, a ţţezzi i ijehliyen.
9:50: Ma iusa k id yiseɣ ad ɣweblen. Ma tusa k id twaɣit, ad inin: "niɣ, iuɣ lḥal, neqḍa lameṛ nneɣ". Ad wexxṛen, zzhan.
9:51: Ini: "ur aɣ iţḥaz wacemma, siwa ayen i ɣ Iura Ṛebbi". Neţţa d Bab nneɣ. ɣef Ṛebbi ara ţţeklen lmumnin.
9:52: Ini: "acu teggunim ad iḍṛu yidneɣ, siwa yiwen si sin iseɣiyen? Nekwni negguni a kwen Iwwet Ṛebbi, s uɛaqeb ara d iasen sɣuṛeS, neɣ seg ifassen nneɣ. Ihi gganit, nekwni a neggani yidwen".
9:53: Ini: "seddqet, tebɣam neɣ tugim, d ayen ur neţţwaqbal segwen, d awezɣi. Kunwi, s tideţ, d agdud iballaɣen".
9:54: Ay sen ikksen a teţwaqbal ssadaqa nnsen, imi kan jehlen, s tideţ, ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, u s laɛgez kan ay d ţţasen ar tţẓallit, s usmiglez kan ay ţseddiqen.
9:55: Ur k iţţaɛoab wayla nnsen, neɣ tarwa nnsen. Ibɣa kan Ṛebbi a ten Iɛaqeb yissen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ad iffeɣ ṛṛuḥ nnsen, nitni d ijehliyen.
9:56: Ad ggalen s Ṛebbi, ar nitni, war ccekk, segwen. Ur nitni segwen, maca d agdud iugaden.
9:57: Lemmer ad afen ssṛan, neɣ ifran, neɣ anda ara kecmen, ad ṛuḥen ɣuṛes s tazla.
9:58: Garasen, wid ikkaten deg k, ɣef ssadaqat. Ma iţţunefk asen segsent, ad ṛaḍin, ma ur asen iţţunefk, ad neḥwen.
9:59: Lemmer nitni, s tideţ, ṛuḍan ayen i sen Ifka Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, u nnan d: "nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi. Ad aɣ d Ifk, si lfeḍl iS, Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ih, d Ṛebbi iɣef neṛɣeb".
9:60: Ssadaqat siwa i imeɣban, iẓawaliyen, i wid iceɣwlen degsent, i usemlili n wulawen, i userreḥ imeḥbas, i imeṭṭulba, i ubrid n Ṛebbi, i win d ifka ubrid. D aḥeţţem sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:61: Garasen, wid icettmen deg Umazan, qqaṛen: "neţţa d aḥessas". Ini: "d aḥessas n lxiṛ i kunwi. Iumen s Ṛebbi, iumen lmumnin. D aḥunu i wid iumnen segwen". I wid icettmen deg Umazan n Ṛebbi, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
9:62: Ad awen ggalen s Ṛebbi, iwakken a kwen ṛaḍin. Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, Iklal kteṛ a T ṛaḍin, lemmer llin d lmumnin.
9:63: Day ur ẓṛin ara ar, win ixuṣmen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, i neţţa times n Loahennama, ad iwekkeṛ degs? D wagi ay d ddell abarar.
9:64: Ixabiten ugaden ad asen d ters tsuṛeţ, ad asen tessken i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "mmaɛlket. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, a d Issuffeɣ ayen tugadem".
9:65: Ma testeqsaḍ ten, a d inin, war ccekk: "la nheddeṛ kan, neţqessiṛ". Ini: "day la tettihim di Ṛebbi akked issekniyen iS, akked Umazan iS?
9:66: Ur steṛoiɛat. Niɣ tuɣalem ar tijehli, deffir liman nnwen". Ma Nsemmeḥ i urbaɛ segwen, a Naɛqeb arbaɛ, imi nitni llan d ibeɣwḍiyen.
9:67: Ixabiten akked txabitin, wa iţţameṛ i wa, ayen n dir, ţţemyegdalen lewqama, ţcuddun ifassen nnsen. Pţun Ṛebbi, Iţţu ten. Ih, ixabiten d iballaɣen.
9:68: Iwaɛɛed Ṛebbi, i ixabiten, txabitin, akked ijehliyen, times n Loahennama, degs ad wekkṛen. Beṛka ten. Ixza ten Ṛebbi. Fellasen aɛaqeb imezgi,
9:69: am imezwura nnwen. Llan ifen kwen tazmert, ɣelben kwen ayla, tarwa. Zhan deg umur nnsen, tezham deg umur nnwen, akken zhan imezwura nnwen deg umur nnsen. Teccḍem akken ccḍen nitni. Widak, mḥan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeṛt. Widak d imexsuṛen.
9:70: Day ur ten id iusa ara usali imezwura nnsen? Agdud n Nuḥ, Ɛad, Tamud, agdud n Ibṛahim, At Median, tid iţţin. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen. Ur ten Idennis Ṛebbi, maca llan dennisen iman nnsen.
9:71: Lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, d imeddukal wa n wa. Pţamṛen lewqama, ţgeddilen ayen n dir. Pẓallan, ţzekkin, ţţaɣen awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Wigi, ad Iḥun Ṛebbi fellasen. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:72: Iwaɛɛed Ṛebbi i lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, ad wekkṛen degsen; ixxamen igerzen di leonanat n Ɛaden, akked llza sɣuṛ Ṛebbi - iten iɣelben akw -. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
9:73: A Nnbi! Jahed ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Iqsiḥ ɣuṛsen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d taggara tucmiţ!
9:74: Ggulen s Ṛebbi ur d nnin, wanag nnan awal n tijehli. Jehlen deffir wannuz nnsen. Vemɛen ayen iwumi ur wɛan. Ur ḥzinen imi iten Iɣat, si lfeḍl iS, Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma steṛoɛen, yif it i nitni. Ma wexxṛen, a ten Iɛaqeb Ṛebbi s leqṛeḥ, di ddunit, di laxeṛt. Ur sɛun, di tmurt, bab neɣ amɛiwen.
9:75: Garasen, wid iɛahden Ṛebbi: "ma Ifka yaɣ d, si lfeḍl iS, a nseddeq, a nili si lɛuṣam".
9:76: Mi sen Ifka si lfeḍl iS, a t bexwlen, ad wexxṛen, ad namren.
9:77: Issegwra yasen d tanaɛuṛt deg ulawen nnsen, ar ass ideg ara mlilen yideS, imi xedɣan Ṛebbi deg wayen i S ɛahden, imi llan skiddiben.
9:78: Day ur ẓṛin ara Ṛebbi Issen sser nnsen akked wayen qqaṛen u, ar Ṛebbi Issen tibaḍniyin?
9:79: Wid iţqeṛṛiḍen di lmumnin i ibɣan ad seddqen, u deg wid i iufan siwa tazmert nnsen, dɣa ttihin fellasen; ad Ittihi Ṛebbi fellasen. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
9:80: Ssuter ad ţţusemmḥen, neɣ qqim. Ma tessutreḍ ṣaḍet iberdan, ur sen Iţsemmiḥ Ṛebbi, d awezɣi. Akka, imi nitni jehlen ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballaɣen.
9:81: Wid igwran, feṛḥen mi llan deffir Umazan n Ṛebbi. Ugin ad nnaɣen s wayla nnsen akked teṛwiḥt nnsen, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Nnan: "Ur ţṛuḥut deg unaɣuṛ". Ini: "times n Loahennama teḥma kteṛ, lemmer day fehhmen".
9:82: Anef ad ḍsen cwiṭ, ad run aṭas, d aqeṭṭi n wayen keţţben.
9:83: Ma Irra k id Ṛebbi ar urbaɛ segsen, u ssutren ak d tsriḥ ad ffɣen, ini: "d awezɣi, ur teţţeffɣem yidi, ur teţnaɣem acengu yidi. Akken, kunwi, iɛoeb ikwen iɣimi, abrid amenzu, ihi, qqimet akked ineggura.
9:84: Ur ţẓalla ɣef yiwen degsen, ma immut, d awezɣi. Ur ţbedda ar tenṭelt is. Nitni, s tideţ, jehlen ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, mmuten nitni d iballaɣen.
9:85: Ur k iţţaɛoab wayla nnsen, neɣ dderya nnsen. Ṛebbi Ibɣa kan a ten Iɛaqeb yissen di ddunit, ad asen teffeɣ taṛwiḥt nitni d ijehliyen.
9:86: Ma ters ed tsuṛeţ: "amnet s Ṛebbi, jahdet akked Umazan iS", imeṛkantiyen nnsen a k ssutren tsriḥ, ad inin: "anef aneɣ ar wid iqqimen".
9:87: Ṛuḍan ad ilin akked wid igwran. Pţuselɣen wulawen nnsen, ur fehhmen.
9:88: Maca, amazan akked wid iumnen yides, jehden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Widak, nnsen lxiṛ. Widak, d nitni ara irebḥen.
9:89: Ihegga yasen d Ṛebbi leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
9:90: Wid id iufan ssebba, seg waɛṛaben n ucluḥ, usan d, ad asen ifk tsriḥ. Wid iskaddben Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, qqimen. Wid ijehlen, segsen, ad sɛaddin aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
9:91: Ur telli tuzzma ɣef uṛhifen, imuḍan, wid ur nufi ara fken, ma neṣḥen ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur telli tuzzma ɣef iɛaṛḍiyen. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
9:92: Am akken, i wid ik id iusan a ten tneqqleḍ, tenniḍ: "ur awen ufiɣ ara kwen ineqqlen". Uɣalen, allen feggḍent seg imeṭṭawen, ɣweblen imi ur ufin ara sedqen.
9:93: Tuzzma kan ɣef wid ik issuturen tsriḥ, nitni d imeṛkantiyen. Ṛuḍan ad ilin akked ineggura. Isleɣ Ṛebbi ulawen nnsen, dɣa ur ssinen.
